recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait canvas lane-battle/card strategy game called **Thronebreak: Petty Crowns**. Preserve the core mechanics of a card hand, influence/elixir economy, lower-half unit deployment, spell deployment, AI unit spawning, towers/bosses, projectile combat, story/survival/shop states, gold rewards, upgrades, and win/loss progression. Reinterpret the play as a satirical medieval succession war: the player is a regent spending court influence to deploy sworn swords, raven archers, gossip harpies, dragon tax machinery, maesters, heirs, exiles, and whispers against rival houses. Use procedural browser-native art: moonlit battlements, frozen moat, oath bridges, banners, crown/throne keeps, red rival houses, dragon and icy apocalypse motifs. Optimize for portrait 4:7 to 9:16 with large tappable cards, readable HUD, and non-blocking overlays.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source identity and behavior
The source is a portrait-first canvas lane-battle/card strategy game. It has a start screen, story briefing, survival mode, shop/upgrades, persistent gold, a timed story battle, AI elixir spending, towers/bosses, unit cards, spell cards, card cycling, sell/refund, entity movement, range attacks, projectiles, particles, floating text, and win/loss overlays.

## Protected mechanics
- Start/story/survival/shop/end states.
- Canvas pointer deployment and card selection.
- Unit deployment restricted to player half; spells can target any side.
- Elixir generation, 10 cap, storm/surge 2x rate, and upgrade modifier.
- AI elixir spending, wave/boss spawning, entity targeting, movement, attack cadence, projectile collision, tower/boss win/loss, gold rewards, story progression, and upgrades.

## Safe theming surfaces
- Title, briefing, HUD labels, card labels/icons, shop copy, toast messages, fonts, palette, DOM panel styling, canvas draw primitives, particle colors, reaction overlays, and audio/GIF choices.

## Remix target
Thronebreak: Petty Crowns reframes the same lane-card battle as a satirical medieval succession war. The player is a regent spending court influence to deploy loyal claimants and absurd court weapons across oath bridges over a frozen moat, seizing rival thrones before the Long Night bureaucracy overwhelms the keep.

identity.title: Thronebreak: Petty Crowns
identity.prompt: Dynasty strategy drama with satirical warring houses, betrayal, dragons, icy apocalypse tension, succession conflict, medieval grandeur, high-stakes power games, and mobile-first portrait UX.
identity.identity: A satirical succession lane-war where royal plots are deployed as cards across a frozen moat to topple rival thrones.
identity.player_role: Scheming regent defending a crowned keep and spending court influence on claimants, ravens, maesters, dragons, and whispers.
identity.core_loop: Earn influence, select a card, deploy or sell it, let units cross oath bridges and fight, collect Crown Coin, upgrade the court, and advance through acts or survive the Long Night.
